jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Unto Labs

Unto Labs is a team of low-level engineers pushing distributed systems to the physical limits of modern hardware. We're reimagining blockchains, from core consensus primitives to performance-tuned networking stacks, in the service of global scale applications.

About the Role

We're seeking a Product Engineer to invent, prototype, and launch breakthrough decentralized finance applications in a venture-studio environment. You will build full-stack mobile and web experiences with React and React Native, contribute to and dogfood our developing tooling (gRPC/TypeScript SDKs) and infrastructure, and iterate quickly to build concepts that hit number-one spots on global app stores. If you live and breathe crypto, love rapid experimentation, are passionate about web technologies, and want to change how mainstream users interact with digital assets, we want to work with you.

Responsibilities

  • Invent, prototype, and launch breakthrough decentralized finance applications in a venture-studio environment.

  • Build full-stack mobile and web experiences with React and React Native.

  • Contribute to and dogfood developing tooling (gRPC/TypeScript SDKs) and agent infrastructure.

  • Iterate quickly to build concepts that rank high on global app stores.

  • Passionate about crypto, rapid experimentation, web technologies, and changing how mainstream users interact with digital assets.

Qualifications:

  • 4+ years building consumer mobile or web apps with significant user traffic.

  • Expert-level React and React Native skills, plus solid TypeScript.

  • Experience building developer-facing SDKs and CLIs.

  • Familiar with gRPC and REST specifications and tooling.

  • Proven ability to turn rough ideas into shipped products at startup speed.

  • Strong sense of product design, usability, and performance on resource-constrained devices.

Why Join Us?

  • Be at the forefront of blockchain technology, working on next-generation consumer crypto applications with a small, fast-moving, tight-knit team.

  • Collaborate with experts in high-frequency trading and scaling developer ecosystems.

  • Shape products that bring crypto to mainstream users.

  • Access to cutting-edge hardware and development tools.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Competitive salary ($170k+ USD)

  • Significant equity and upside potential.

  • Flexible work environment.

  • Unlimited vacation policy.

  • Health insurance.

  • Hardware and development tool allowance.

  • Conference and learning budget.

jobs.title: Marketing Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Unto Labs

Unto Labs delivers products that change how individuals interact with their money. We're developing the open standards for the Thru blockchain (thru.org). We solve problems at the intersection of developers, enterprise, and consumer needs. We're building the next generation of blockchain technology, from core consensus primitives to performance-tuned networking stacks, on commodity servers.

About the Role

We are seeking a driven and strategic Founding Go-to-Market (GTM) leader to define and tell Unto Labs’ story. You will own the development and refinement of our marketing strategy, furthering our brand narrative, crafting messaging for deeply technical & financial products, and leading the charge on campaigns to engage wide-ranging audiences, including developers, partners, and the general public. You’ll collaborate across engineering, product, and creative to position Unto Labs as a leading infrastructure provider and distinctive technology brand.

Responsibilities

  • Define and evolve Unto Labs’ marketing strategy, brand positioning, and messaging to reach both technical and mainstream stakeholders.

  • Design and execute campaigns for product launches, ecosystem milestones, developer events, and community initiatives.

  • Build scalable content and communication systems across web, social, and advertising channels/

  • Translate complex technical concepts from consensus protocols, cryptography, distributed systems into clear and compelling stories that resonate with both crypto-native and mainstream audiences.

  • Guide and produce collateral including website copy, pitch decks, press releases, blog posts, and multimedia.

  • Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and creative teams to capture and convey Unto Labs' and Thru's unique value.

  • Drive GTM initiatives including partnerships, event presence, and outreach.

  • Measure and analyze marketing efforts to optimize reach and effectiveness.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in GTM, brand marketing, or communications roles, preferably with technical or startup organizations.

  • Proven ability to shape messaging for highly technical products and communicate to broad audiences.

  • Experience building out creative and memorable marketing campaigns and brand strategy from an early stage.

  • Skilled at distilling complex topics into approachable narratives for both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with video production, design, or multimedia storytelling

  • Familiarity with blockchain, crypto, or distributed systems

  • Portfolio demonstrating brand, campaign, or product marketing

Why Join Us?

  • Shape and own the GTM and marketing function at a company at the frontier of distributed systems, financial, and blockchain innovation.

  • Collaborate with a founding team of world-class engineers to define the voice of groundbreaking technology.

  • Influence company direction as an early hire with room to grow.

  • Work with top-tier tools and budgets in a flexible, supportive environment.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive salary and significant equity upside

  • Flexible work environment

  • Unlimited vacation policy

  • Health insurance

  • Hardware and tool allowance

  • Conference and learning budget

jobs.title: General Counsel
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Unto Labs

Unto Labs is a team of low-level engineers pushing distributed systems to the physical limits of modern hardware. We're building the next generation of blockchain technology, from core consensus primitives to performance-tuned networking stacks, on commodity servers.

About the Role

As General Counsel, you will establish and lead the company's legal strategy with the founders across a broad range of areas, including regulatory compliance, corporate governance, commercial transactions, employment matters, intellectual property, and dispute resolution.

You'll build and lead the company's legal function across a wide range of areas, including regulatory compliance, corporate matters, commercial agreements, employment issues, intellectual property, and disputes. You'll be a trusted partner to the founders and work closely with everyone.

As part of a small, high caliber team, this is a critical, hands-on, cross-functional role that goes beyond traditional legal advice. You'll create practical compliance programs, develop internal policies, and put processes in place that support the launch and growth of innovative financial products. We're looking for someone who enjoys tackling complex regulatory challenges, turning legal requirements into workable solutions, and helping the company scale responsibly.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the company's approach to legal and regulatory matters across the U.S. ((SEC, CFTC, FinCEN, OFAC, state MTLs)) and internationally (MiCA, FCA, MAS), while staying ahead of regulatory developments and working directly with regulators when necessary.

  • Lead deal work: M&A, strategic investments, financings, joint ventures, etc. and draft, negotiate, and operationalize the full commercial contract stack: customer, partner, vendor, BD, integration, and protocol partnership agreements.

  • Own the company's intellectual property strategy, including trademarks, licensing, and open-source software considerations.

  • Manage disputes, regulatory inquiries, subpoenas, investigations, and other legal matters as they arise. Select and oversee outside counsel and ensure legal resources are used effectively, when necessary.

  • Structure and maintain the company's corporate architecture and governance across multiple entities.

  • Build legal and compliance processes that can scale with the company while balancing risk, regulatory requirements, and speed of execution.

  • Advise and work with founders on best practices for entity structuring, digital tokens and onchain incentivestokenomics and securities, innovative business models, and compliance solutions.

Requirements

Candidates must have both a Bachelor’s Degree and Juris Doctor from top schools, experience at a top law firm, and 7+ years of experience with:

  • Counseling financial services companies on a broad range of matters, including general business matters, regulatory matters, corporate governance, and technology transfers, with a focus on strategic transactions, and mergers and acquisitions.

  • Proactive business mindset: someone who operates effectively as the sole lawyer, with impeccable organization, project management, and communication skills.

  • Translating complex regulatory requirements into practical product and operational guidance for non-lawyer business partners and colleagues.

  • Advising senior executives on nuanced matters with limited information, and is comfortable being the last set of eyes before product ships.

  • Improving processes and building out new systems from scratch.

  • Toggling between strategic thinking and tactical execution, and adjusting priorities in response to unanticipated events with minimal oversight.

We are even more interested in chatting if you have

  • In-house experience at a product-led crypto, DeFi, or fintech company—especially if you helped it to grow.

  • Deep understanding of CFTC regulation, including experience advising on, preparing, or managing CFTC regulatory filings, rule submissions, or examination responses.

  • Established and maintained multi-entity corporate structures, including offshore affiliates and operating subsidiaries across multiple jurisdictions.

Why Join Us?

  • Shape and own legal structure and strategy at a startup at the frontier of distributed systems, the future of financial innovation, and blockchain infrastructure

  • Work directly with a founding team of world-class engineers to position innovative technology for widespread adoption

  • Own the entire legal function as an early hire with substantial influence over company direction

  • Competitive compensation, equity, and generous benefits

EEO Statement

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran or military status, marital status, gender identity, sexual orientation, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
